title: Fueling Austin's Power, Paving Streets
summary:
*   **Ensuring City Utilities:** Secured a crucial contract for coal fuel for the city's Water, Light, and Power Plant at $1.55 per ton for the first half of 1919, guaranteeing essential services.
*   **Infrastructure Improvement:** Approved payment for paving a city intersection.
*   **Local Governance:** Addressed two individual fines.

December 17, 1918.
Councilman Bartholomew offered the following resolution: RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF
THE CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS: That the Superintendent of Parks and Public Property of the
City of Austin, Texas, be and he is hereby authorized to contract with Ira Perry of
Rockdale, Texas, for fuel for the Water, Light and Power Plant of this city at the rate of
$1.55 per ton, f. o. b. cars Rockdale, Texas, for the six months of the year 1919
terminating
July 1st of that year.
The resolution was adopted by a vote of 5 yeas, no nays.
APPROVED, Dec. 17, 1918: A. P. Wooldridge, Mayor.
